text: Thomas Clark Way was dedicated as a future public street more than a decade ago but remains unassumed because the City has not completed the road extension required to bring it into the municipal road network. While the adjacent developments have long since been completed and occupied, repeated delays to the City's construction schedule have left the roadway in administrative limbo, with no clear responsibility for essential public infrastructure. In 2022, as part of IA38.1 and Answer IA38.1a on Status of Thomas Clark Way Extension, City staff advised that construction of the Thomas Clark Way extension was expected to begin in 2023 after work had been delayed during the COVID-19 pandemic. That timeline was subsequently pushed to August 2026, and the Councillors office has now been advised that construction has been delayed again until at least April 2027. City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct the General Manager, Transportation Services, through the Transportation Electrical Construction and Maintenance Group, in consultation with Toronto Hydro, to undertake the necessary repairs to the lighting on Thomas Clark Drive in advance of the full road assumption.
